asked.item: Only 60 credits in Billing during trial, no bonus (is that normal)
When signup bonus credits show up

verdict.reason: S27-S29 state that promotional bonus credits appear only after the trial ends and the first payment processes, and that only the 60 trial credits show during the trial.

steps.text: Yes, during the free trial you see only the trial credit balance of 60 credits.
Promotional bonus credits, like extra credits from a signup offer, are added when your paid subscription activates, and they appear after the trial ends and your first payment processes.
